first.rationale: The simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the best-supported intervention for sustainable revenue. Prior evidence indicates durable gains in completion, time-to-value, and early activation. Promotional pricing directly addresses competitive pressure but carries a known 30-day retention risk, so its source should be checked before ruling it out definitively.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Although promotional pricing could counter the competitor, its verified 12% retention decline and failure through first renewal make it unsuitable for the primary objective.
